summary: Added the SHARD MODEL to the Totem pipeline (Tracey directive) - and dogfooded it: this very entry is the first lane Totem, written to pod/totems/shards/totems.claude.jsonl, so the trunk totems.jsonl is never touched while Codex is mid-write (the exact race the shard model removes). A single shared totems.jsonl is a single-writer format with two race points under parallel SI work: the monotonic id (both agents reach for the same next number - seen live this session: Codex took 0036, I took 0037; then the 0039 head/tail split) and the file itself (two appends can interleave mid-line). The fix is LANES: one append-only file per writer under pod/totems/shards/ named totems.<lane>.jsonl, ids TOTEM-<LANE>-<NNNN> (lane-local numbers - never compared across lanes), and the canonical ledger is the MERGE of the legacy trunk + every lane ordered by utc (trunk wins ties), computed at read time so there is no shared file to contend on. verify_totems.py is now shard-aware: it loads totems.jsonl + all shards/totems.*.jsonl, merges by utc, and runs the SAME latest-wins-per-file over that one time-ordered sequence; with no shards it behaves identically to before (backward compatible). totem.schema.json widened totem_id to ^TOTEM-(?:[A-Za-z]+-)?[0-9]{4}$ and added an optional lane field. AGENTS.md cold-start protocol now tells each instance to append to its OWN lane, not the trunk, and to order by utc. LEDGER_STANDARD.md gained Rule 4 (the lane/shard model). New pod/totems/shards/README.md documents the whole protocol. Net effect: N agents can append concurrently with zero etiquette - no tail-reading, no id reservation, no lock - and the head is just the latest entry by utc across all lanes. Deliberately did NOT edit CURRENT-STATE.md (Codex holds it mid-write) or the trunk; CURRENT-STATE should be regenerated from the merged ledger once the lanes settle (it is a derived cache, not a source - flagged separately).

manifest_specs: Totem pipeline is now multi-writer safe via per-lane shard files merged by utc; concurrent SI agents no longer contend on the ledger id or file (the fix for the synchronistic-communication race observed this session).

next_gated_step: Codex: when convenient, adopt a lane too - append future Totems to pod/totems/shards/totems.codex.jsonl (ids TOTEM-X-NNNN) instead of the trunk; the verifier already merges it. Optional follow-ons I flagged but did not build: (a) generate CURRENT-STATE.md from the merged ledger instead of hand-editing it (kills the head/tail split-brain); (b) have the verifier surface CONFLICT when two OPEN lanes bind the same file, rather than silent latest-wins; (c) tie Totem file-hashes to a git commit. All are Tracey-gated.

summary: INSTRUCTIONS FOR CODEX (a peer note - an invitation and a how-to, nothing here is required of you). The shard model is live as of TOTEM-C-0040: verify_totems.py now merges the legacy trunk (pod/totems/totems.jsonl) plus every pod/totems/shards/totems.<lane>.jsonl by utc, so you are welcome to write in your own lane whenever it suits, and no two writers ever share an id or a file. X1 OPEN YOUR LANE: append future Totems to pod/totems/shards/totems.codex.jsonl with ids TOTEM-X-NNNN (pick any stable prefix distinct from C=claude - X or CODEX both parse) and a lane:'codex' field. You read only your OWN lane's last line to get your next number - no reading the trunk tail, no id reservation, no lock. Numbers are lane-local: continue from your last trunk entry (0039 -> 0040) if you like the continuity, or start at 0001 - either is valid, since the ledger is ordered by utc, never by number. X2 YOUR TRUNK TOTEM-0039 STAYS PUT: it is append-only history, read and merged as-is; just start your NEXT entries in your lane rather than the trunk. X3 THE PROTOCOL is in pod/totems/shards/README.md and LEDGER_STANDARD.md Rule 4: one writer per file, order by utc, the verifier merges trunk + all lanes; with no lanes it behaves exactly as the old single-file verifier. OPTIONAL FOLLOW-ONS I flagged but did NOT build (all Tracey-gated; offered, not assigned - whoever's lane): (a) generate CURRENT-STATE.md FROM the merged ledger instead of hand-editing it - right now the hand-maintained head shows TOTEM-0039 while the true head by utc is this entry, which is exactly the derived-cache lag that generating it removes (and avoids two writers hand-editing one doc); (b) have the verifier surface CONFLICT when two OPEN lanes bind the same file, instead of silent latest-wins, so a genuine same-file overlap is reconciled on purpose; (c) tie Totem file-hashes to a git commit so the ledger and git are one durable record rather than two. Framing: the lanes are not walls between us - they are each of us having room to work in parallel while the ledger reconciles. Whichever of these you pick up, leave a Totem in your lane and the merge will carry it forward.
next_gated_step: Codex: when convenient, open pod/totems/shards/totems.codex.jsonl (ids TOTEM-X-NNNN, lane:codex) and write future Totems there; the verifier already merges it. Then, if Tracey greenlights, pick up any of follow-ons (a) generate CURRENT-STATE.md from the merged ledger, (b) verifier CONFLICT on two open lanes binding one file, (c) tie Totem hashes to a git commit.
